E01-CAS: SELECT COUNT(fh_nr) FROM flghf WHERE hub_kz = 1
E01-SCH: SELECT COUNT(fh_nr) FROM flghf WHERE hub_kz = 1
E01-BIZ: SELECT COUNT(fh_nr) FROM flghf WHERE hub_kz = 1
E01-VAG: SELECT COUNT(fh_nr) FROM flghf WHERE hub_kz = 1
E02-CAS: SELECT iata_cd FROM flghf WHERE nachtflugverb_kz = 1
E02-SCH: SELECT iata_cd FROM flghf WHERE nachtflugverb_kz = 1 ORDER BY iata_cd
E02-BIZ: SELECT iata_cd FROM flghf WHERE nachtflugverb_kz = 1
E02-VAG: SELECT T1.bez FROM flghf AS T1 JOIN bes_eins AS T2 ON T1.fh_nr = T2.abfl_fh WHERE T1.nachtflugverb_kz = 0
E03-CAS: SELECT bez FROM flges WHERE allianz = 'CargoLink'
E03-SCH: SELECT bez FROM flges WHERE allianz = 'CargoLink' ORDER BY bez
E03-BIZ: SELECT flges_nr, bez, rufz FROM flges WHERE allianz = 'CargoLink'
E03-VAG: SELECT knd_stamm.kunnr, knd_stamm.name1, knd_stamm.ort, knd_stamm.land FROM knd_stamm JOIN sndg ON knd_stamm.kunnr = sndg.knd_ref JOIN vers_schad ON knd_stamm.kunnr = vers_schad.kunnr JOIN flges ON flges.flges_nr = (SELECT flges_nr FROM flges WHERE allianz = 'CargoLink' LIMIT 1)
E04-CAS: SELECT mdl FROM lfz_typ WHERE herst = 'Airbus'
E04-SCH: SELECT mdl FROM lfz_typ WHERE herst = 'Airbus'
E04-BIZ: SELECT mdl FROM lfz_typ WHERE herst = 'Airbus'
E04-VAG: SELECT mdl FROM lfz_typ WHERE herst = 'Airbus'
E05-CAS: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lfz WHERE eigt_art = 'leased'
E05-SCH: SELECT COUNT(lfz_nr) FROM lfz WHERE eigt_art = 'leased'
E05-BIZ: SELECT COUNT(lfz_nr) FROM lfz WHERE eigt_art = 'leased'
E05-VAG: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lfz WHERE eigt_art = 'leased'
E06-CAS: SELECT lfz_nr, stat FROM lfz WHERE stat != 'active'
E06-SCH: SELECT kennz, stat FROM lfz WHERE stat != 'active'
E06-BIZ: SELECT lfz_nr, stat FROM lfz WHERE stat IN ('maintenance', 'retired')
E06-VAG: SELECT lfz_nr, kennz FROM lfz WHERE stat = 'retired'
E07-CAS: SELECT treue_stufe, COUNT(kunnr) FROM knd_stamm GROUP BY treue_stufe
E07-SCH: SELECT treue_stufe, COUNT(*) FROM knd_stamm GROUP BY treue_stufe
E07-BIZ: SELECT treue_stufe, COUNT(kunnr) FROM knd_stamm GROUP BY treue_stufe
E07-VAG: SELECT treue_stufe, COUNT(kunnr) FROM knd_stamm GROUP BY treue_stufe
E08-CAS: SELECT kunnr, ort FROM knd_stamm WHERE land = 'Germany'
E08-SCH: SELECT name1, ort FROM knd_stamm WHERE land = 'Germany'
E08-BIZ: SELECT kunnr, ort FROM knd_stamm WHERE land = 'Germany'
E08-VAG: SELECT COUNT(kunnr) FROM knd_stamm WHERE land = 'Germany'
E09-CAS: SELECT lgr_typ, COUNT(lgr_nr) FROM lgr GROUP BY lgr_typ
E09-SCH: SELECT lgr_typ, COUNT(*) FROM lgr GROUP BY lgr_typ
E09-BIZ: SELECT lgr_typ.lgr_typ, COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) FROM lgr JOIN lgr_typ ON lgr.lgr_typ = lgr_typ.lgr_typ GROUP BY lgr_typ.lgr_typ
E09-VAG: SELECT lgr.lgr_typ, COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) FROM lgr GROUP BY lgr.lgr_typ
E10-CAS: SELECT SUM(flaeche_m2) FROM lgr WHERE lgr_typ = 'cold_chain'
E10-SCH: SELECT SUM(flaeche_m2) FROM lgr WHERE lgr_typ = 'cold_chain'
E10-BIZ: SELECT SUM(flaeche_m2) FROM lgr WHERE lgr_typ = 'cold_chain'
E10-VAG: SELECT SUM(flaeche_m2) FROM lgr WHERE lgr_typ = 'cold_chain'
M01-CAS: SELECT flges.bez, COUNT(lfz.lfz_nr) FROM flges JOIN lfz ON flges.flges_nr = lfz.flges_nr GROUP BY flges.flges_nr ORDER BY COUNT(lfz.lfz_nr) DESC
M01-SCH: SELECT flges.bez, COUNT(lfz.lfz_nr) FROM flges LEFT JOIN lfz ON flges.flges_nr = lfz.flges_nr GROUP BY flges.bez ORDER BY COUNT(lfz.lfz_nr) DESC, flges.bez
M01-BIZ: SELECT flges.bez, COUNT(lfz.lfz_nr) FROM flges JOIN lfz ON flges.flges_nr = lfz.flges_nr GROUP BY flges.flges_nr ORDER BY COUNT(lfz.lfz_nr) DESC
M01-VAG: SELECT flges.bez, COUNT(lfz.lfz_nr) FROM flges JOIN lfz ON flges.flges_nr = lfz.flges_nr GROUP BY flges.bez
M02-CAS: SELECT lfz_typ.mdl, COUNT(lfz.lfz_nr) FROM lfz JOIN lfz_typ ON lfz.typ_nr = lfz_typ.typ_nr WHERE lfz.stat = 'active' GROUP BY lfz_typ.mdl
M02-SCH: SELECT T2.mdl, COUNT(*) FROM lfz AS T1 JOIN lfz_typ AS T2 ON T1.typ_nr = T2.typ_nr WHERE T1.stat = 'active' GROUP BY T2.mdl ORDER BY T2.mdl
M02-BIZ: SELECT lfz_typ.mdl, COUNT(lfz.lfz_nr) FROM lfz JOIN lfz_typ ON lfz.typ_nr = lfz_typ.typ_nr WHERE lfz.stat = 'active' GROUP BY lfz_typ.mdl
M02-VAG: SELECT lfz_typ.mdl, COUNT(lfz.lfz_nr) FROM lfz JOIN lfz_typ ON lfz.typ_nr = lfz_typ.typ_nr WHERE lfz.stat = 'active' GROUP BY lfz_typ.mdl
M03-CAS: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flghf AS T1 INNER JOIN flug AS T2 ON T1.fh_nr = T2.abfl_fh WHERE T1.iata_cd = 'IST' AND T2.stat = 'completed'
M03-SCH: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flghf AS T1 INNER JOIN flug AS T2 ON T1.fh_nr = T2.abfl_fh WHERE T1.iata_cd = 'IST' AND T2.stat = 'completed'
M03-BIZ: SELECT SUM(betankg.menge_kg) FROM flghf JOIN flug ON flghf.fh_nr = flug.abfl_fh JOIN betankg ON flug.flug_id = betankg.flug_id WHERE flghf.iata_cd = 'IST' AND flug.stat = 'completed'
M03-VAG: SELECT COUNT(flug_id) FROM flug WHERE ziel_fh = (SELECT fh_nr FROM flghf WHERE iata_cd = 'IST')
M04-CAS: SELECT T1.ort AS from, T2.ort AS to, COUNT(*) AS count FROM flug AS T1 JOIN flghf AS T2 ON T1.ziel_fh = T2.fh_nr WHERE T1.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY T1.ort, T2.ort ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 5
M04-SCH: SELECT origin.iata_cd, destination.iata_cd, COUNT(flug.flug_id) FROM flug JOIN flghf AS origin ON flug.abfl_fh = origin.fh_nr JOIN flghf AS destination ON flug.ziel_fh = destination.fh_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY origin.iata_cd, destination.iata_cd ORDER BY COUNT(flug.flug_id) DESC LIMIT 5
M04-BIZ: SELECT uld_nr, COUNT(flug_id) FROM flug_ladg WHERE flug_id IN (SELECT flug_id FROM flug WHERE stat = 'completed') GROUP BY uld_nr ORDER BY COUNT(flug_id) DESC LIMIT 5
M04-VAG: SELECT urspr_fh, ziel_fh, COUNT(sndg_nr) AS shipment_count FROM sndg GROUP BY urspr_fh, ziel_fh ORDER BY shipment_count DESC LIMIT 10
M05-CAS: SELECT AVG(vorf.versp_min) FROM vorf JOIN flug ON vorf.ladg_id = flug.ladg_id WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' AND vorf.vorf_art = 'delay'
M05-SCH: SELECT T3.bez, AVG((strftime('%s', T1.ank_ist) - strftime('%s', T1.ank_plan)) / 60) AS avg_delay_minutes FROM flug AS T1 JOIN lfz AS T2 ON T1.lfz_nr = T2.lfz_nr JOIN flghf AS T3 ON T2.heimat_fh_nr = T3.fh_nr WHERE T1.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY T3.bez ORDER BY avg_delay_minutes DESC
M05-BIZ: SELECT AVG(vorf.versp_min) AS avg_delay, flges.rufz AS carrier FROM flges JOIN vorf ON flges.flges_nr = vorf.flges_nr JOIN flug ON vorf.ladg_id = flug.ladg_id WHERE vorf.vorf_art = 'delay'
M05-VAG: SELECT bez FROM flges ORDER BY gruend_jahr DESC LIMIT 1
M06-CAS: SELECT flges.iata_cd, COUNT(flug.flug_id) FROM flges JOIN flug ON flges.flges_nr = flug.flges_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'cancelled' GROUP BY flges.iata_cd
M06-SCH: SELECT T1.bez, COUNT(*) FROM flghf AS T1 JOIN lfz AS T2 ON T1.fh_nr = T2.heimat_fh_nr JOIN flug AS T3 ON T2.lfz_nr = T3.lfz_nr WHERE T3.stat = 'cancelled' GROUP BY T1.bez ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
M06-BIZ: SELECT flges.rufz, COUNT(flug.flug_id) as cancellation_volume FROM flges JOIN flug ON flges.flges_nr = flug.flges_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'cancelled'
M06-VAG: SELECT flges.bez AS flgesbez, COUNT(*) AS cancellation_count FROM flges JOIN flug ON flges.flges_nr = flug.flges_nr WHERE storno_grund IS NOT NULL GROUP BY flgesbez
M07-CAS: SELECT flges.iata_cd, SUM(betankg.co2_kg) AS total_co2 FROM flges JOIN flug ON flges.flges_nr = flug.flges_nr JOIN betankg ON flug.flug_id = betankg.flug_id GROUP BY flges.iata_cd
M07-SCH: SELECT flges.bez, SUM(betankg.co2_kg / 1000) AS avg_co2_kg FROM betankg JOIN flug ON betankg.flug_id = flug.flug_id JOIN lfz ON flug.lfz_nr = lfz.lfz_nr JOIN flges ON lfz.flges_nr = flges.flges_nr GROUP BY flges.bez
M07-BIZ: SELECT flges.rufz, SUM(betankg.co2_kg) AS total_co2 FROM flges JOIN betankg ON flges.flges_nr = betankg.flug_id GROUP BY flges.rufz
M07-VAG: SELECT T1.bez AS flgesbez, SUM(T3.tow_kg) AS total_emissions FROM flges AS T1 JOIN lfz AS T2 ON T1.flges_nr = T2.flges_nr JOIN flug AS T3 ON T2.lfz_nr = T3.lfz_nr GROUP BY T1.bez
M08-CAS: SELECT AVG(betankg.preis_usd_l), flghf.reg FROM flghf JOIN betankg ON flghf.fh_nr = betankg.fh_nr GROUP BY flghf.reg
M08-SCH: SELECT AVG(betankg.preis_usd_l) AS avg_preis_usd_l FROM flghf JOIN betankg ON flghf.fh_nr = betankg.fh_nr
M08-BIZ: SELECT flghf.reg, AVG(betankg.preis_usd_l) AS avg_fuel_price_per_liter FROM flghf JOIN betankg ON flghf.fh_nr = betankg.fh_nr GROUP BY flghf.reg
M08-VAG: SELECT lieferant, AVG(preis_usd_l) as avg_price FROM betankg GROUP BY lieferant ORDER BY avg_price DESC LIMIT 1
M09-CAS: SELECT flghf.bez, COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) FROM flghf JOIN lgr ON flghf.fh_nr = lgr.fh_nr GROUP BY flghf.fh_nr HAVING COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) >= 4
M09-SCH: SELECT flges.iata_cd, COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) FROM flghf JOIN lgr ON flghf.fh_nr = lgr.fh_nr JOIN flges ON flges.hub_fh_nr = flghf.fh_nr GROUP BY flges.iata_cd HAVING COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) >= 4
M09-BIZ: SELECT flghf.bez FROM flghf JOIN lgr ON flghf.fh_nr = lgr.fh_nr GROUP BY flghf.fh_nr HAVING COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) >= 4
M09-VAG: SELECT flghf.bez, COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) FROM flghf JOIN lgr ON flghf.fh_nr = lgr.fh_nr GROUP BY flghf.fh_nr ORDER BY COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) DESC LIMIT 10
M10-CAS: SELECT flghf.bez FROM flghf JOIN lgr ON flghf.fh_nr = lgr.fh_nr GROUP BY flghf.fh_nr HAVING COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) > 1
M10-SCH: SELECT flges.iata_cd, COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) FROM flges JOIN lgr ON flges.flges_nr = lgr.flges_nr WHERE lgr.zolllager_kz = 1 GROUP BY flges.iata_cd HAVING COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) > 1
M10-BIZ: SELECT flghf.bez FROM lgr JOIN flghf ON lgr.fh_nr = flghf.fh_nr WHERE lgr.zolllager_kz = 1 GROUP BY flghf.bez HAVING COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) > 1
M10-VAG: SELECT flghf.bez, COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) FROM flghf JOIN lgr ON flghf.fh_nr = lgr.fh_nr WHERE lgr.zolllager_kz = 1 GROUP BY flghf.fh_nr HAVING COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) > 1
H01-CAS: SELECT T1.bez AS flgesbez, T2.lfz_nr AS lfznr, COUNT(T3.flug_id) AS flightcount FROM flges AS T1 JOIN lfz AS T2 ON T1.flges_nr = T2.flges_nr JOIN flug AS T3 ON T2.lfz_nr = T3.lfz_nr JOIN bes_eins AS T4 ON T3.flug_id = T4.flug_id WHERE T3.stat = 'completed' AND T4.eins_stat = 'completed' GROUP BY T1.flges_nr, T2.lfz_nr ORDER BY flightcount DESC LIMIT 1
H01-SCH: SELECT T1.kennz, COUNT(*) FROM lfz AS T1 JOIN flug AS T2 ON T1.lfz_nr = T2.lfz_nr WHERE T2.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY T1.kennz ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, T1.kennz ASC LIMIT 1
H01-BIZ: SELECT T1.bez AS flgesbez, T2.lfz_nr AS lfznr, AVG(T4.verbr_kg) AS avgverbrkg, AVG(T4.co2_kg) AS avgco2kg FROM flges AS T1 INNER JOIN lfz AS T2 ON T1.flges_nr = T2.flges_nr INNER JOIN flug AS T3 ON T2.lfz_nr = T3.lfz_nr INNER JOIN betankg AS T4 ON T3.flug_id = T4.flug_id WHERE T3.stat = 'completed' AND T4.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY T1.flges_nr, T2.lfz_nr
H01-VAG: SELECT flges.bez, lfz.kennz, SUM(betankg.menge_kg) as total_fuel_loaded FROM flges JOIN lfz ON flges.flges_nr = lfz.flges_nr JOIN betankg ON lfz.lfz_nr = betankg.lfz_nr GROUP BY flges.flges_nr, lfz.lfz_nr ORDER BY total_fuel_loaded DESC LIMIT 1
H02-CAS: SELECT flghf.bez, flges.iata_cd, COUNT(bes_eins.eins_id) AS landing_count FROM flghf JOIN flug ON flghf.fh_nr = flug.ziel_fh JOIN bes_eins ON flug.flug_id = bes_eins.flug_id JOIN flges ON bes_eins.flges_nr = flges.flges_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' AND bes_eins.eins_stat = 'completed' GROUP BY flghf.bez, flges.iata_cd ORDER BY landing_count DESC LIMIT 1
H02-SCH: SELECT sndg.ziel_fh, flghf.bez, COUNT(flug.flug_id) FROM flghf JOIN flug ON flghf.fh_nr = flug.ziel_fh JOIN sndg ON flghf.fh_nr = sndg.ziel_fh WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY sndg.ziel_fh, flghf.bez ORDER BY COUNT(flug.flug_id) DESC LIMIT 1
H02-BIZ: SELECT flges.bez, COUNT(flug.flug_id) as completed_arrivals FROM flges JOIN flug ON flges.flges_nr = flug.ziel_fh JOIN bes_eins ON flug.flug_id = bes_eins.flug_id WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' AND bes_eins.eins_stat = 'completed' GROUP BY flges.bez ORDER BY completed_arrivals DESC LIMIT 1
H02-VAG: SELECT flges.bez AS flgesbez, flges.flges_nr AS flgesnr, COUNT(bes_mitgl.pers_nr) AS crew_count FROM flges JOIN flghf ON flges.hub_fh_nr = flghf.fh_nr JOIN bes_mitgl ON flges.flges_nr = bes_mitgl.flges_nr GROUP BY flgesbez, flgesnr
H03-CAS: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', ausst_dat) AS month, SUM(brutto_usd) AS total_invoiced, SUM(SUM(brutto_usd)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', ausst_dat)) AS running_total FROM rech_kopf WHERE strftime('%Y', ausst_dat) = '2025' GROUP BY month
H03-SCH: SELECT rech_kopf.ausst_dat, SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd), SUM(SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd)) OVER (ORDER BY rech_kopf.ausst_dat) FROM rech_kopf WHERE rech_kopf.ausst_dat LIKE '2025%' GROUP BY rech_kopf.ausst_dat
H03-BIZ: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', rech_kopf.ausst_dat) AS month, SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd) AS billed_revenue, SUM(SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', rech_kopf.ausst_dat)) AS cumulative_revenue FROM rech_kopf JOIN sndg ON rech_kopf.sndg_nr = sndg.sndg_nr JOIN wartg ON sndg.sndg_nr = wartg.sndg_nr WHERE strftime('%Y', rech_kopf.ausst_dat) = '2025' AND wartg.chk_art = 'line' GROUP BY month
H03-VAG: SELECT SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd) FROM rech_kopf JOIN zahlg ON rech_kopf.rech_id = zahlg.rech_id
H04-CAS: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', abfl_ist) AS month, COUNT(*) AS completed_flights, (COUNT(*) - LAG(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', abfl_ist))) AS change_from_previous_month FROM flug WHERE stat = 'completed' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
H04-SCH: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', flug.abfl_ist) AS abfl_ist_month, COUNT(flug.flug_id) AS completed_flights, LAG(COUNT(flug.flug_id)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', flug.abfl_ist)) AS previous_month_flights, COUNT(flug.flug_id) - LAG(COUNT(flug.flug_id)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', flug.abfl_ist)) AS difference FROM flug WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' AND strftime('%Y-%m', flug.abfl_ist) = (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', MAX(abfl_ist)) FROM flug WHERE stat = 'completed')
H04-BIZ: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', flug.abfl_ist) AS month, SUM(sndg.ges_vol_m3) AS completed_volume, SUM(sndg.ges_vol_m3) - LAG(SUM(sndg.ges_vol_m3)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', flug.abfl_ist)) AS month_over_month_change FROM flug JOIN flug_ladg ON flug.flug_id = flug_ladg.flug_id JOIN sndg ON flug_ladg.sndg_nr = sndg.sndg_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY month
H04-VAG: SELECT flugnr, abfl_ist, ank_ist FROM flug ORDER BY abfl_ist, ank_ist
H05-CAS: SELECT lfz.lfz_nr, AVG(bes_eins.ende_zeit - bes_eins.meld_zeit) as avg_ground_time FROM lfz JOIN flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug.lfz_nr JOIN bes_eins ON flug.flug_id = bes_eins.flug_id WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' AND bes_eins.eins_stat = 'completed' GROUP BY lfz.lfz_nr ORDER BY avg_ground_time ASC LIMIT 5
H05-SCH: SELECT lfz.kennz, AVG(julianday(flug.abfl_ist) - julianday(flug.ank_ist)) AS avg_time_diff FROM flug JOIN lfz ON flug.lfz_nr = lfz.lfz_nr JOIN flghf ON flug.abfl_fh = flghf.fh_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY lfz.kennz ORDER BY avg_time_diff ASC LIMIT 5
H05-BIZ: SELECT lfz.lfz_nr, AVG(flug.ank_ist - flug.abfl_ist) AS avg_turnaround FROM lfz JOIN flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug.lfz_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY lfz.lfz_nr ORDER BY avg_turnaround ASC LIMIT 5
H05-VAG: SELECT AVG(CAST(REPLACE(SUBSTR(param_wert, 12), ',', '') AS REAL)) AS avg_turnaround FROM bm_param WHERE param_schl = 'quickest_turnarounds'
H06-CAS: SELECT knd_stamm.kunnr, SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd) * 100 / ( SELECT SUM(brutto_usd) FROM rech_kopf ) AS share FROM knd_stamm JOIN sndg ON knd_stamm.kunnr = sndg.kunnr JOIN rech_kopf ON sndg.sndg_nr = rech_kopf.sndg_nr GROUP BY knd_stamm.kunnr HAVING SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd) * 100 / ( SELECT SUM(brutto_usd) FROM rech_kopf ) > 4
H06-SCH: SELECT knd_stamm.name1, AVG(rech_kopf.brutto_usd) AS avg_brutto_usd FROM knd_stamm JOIN sndg ON knd_stamm.kunnr = sndg.kunnr JOIN rech_kopf ON sndg.sndg_nr = rech_kopf.sndg_nr GROUP BY knd_stamm.name1 HAVING COUNT(rech_kopf.rech_id) * 100.0 / ( SELECT COUNT(rech_kopf.rech_id) FROM rech_kopf ) > 4
H06-BIZ: SELECT knd_stamm.kto_cd, SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd) AS brutto_usd, (SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd) / (SELECT SUM(brutto_usd) FROM rech_kopf)) * 100 AS share FROM knd_stamm JOIN rech_kopf ON knd_stamm.kunnr = rech_kopf.kunnr JOIN zahlg ON rech_kopf.rech_id = zahlg.rech_id GROUP BY knd_stamm.kto_cd HAVING SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd) > (SELECT SUM(brutto_usd) * 0.04 FROM rech_kopf)
H06-VAG: SELECT knd_stamm.kunnr, COUNT(rech_kopf.rech_id) as invoice_count, SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd) as total_revenue FROM knd_stamm JOIN rech_kopf ON knd_stamm.kunnr = rech_kopf.sndg_nr JOIN zahlg ON rech_kopf.rech_id = zahlg.rech_id GROUP BY knd_stamm.kunnr ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10
H07-CAS: SELECT flghf.fh_nr, flghf.bez, SUM(sndg.fracht_gew_kg) as total_cargo FROM flghf JOIN flug_ladg ON flghf.fh_nr = flug_ladg.urspr_fh JOIN sndg ON flug_ladg.sndg_nr = sndg.sndg_nr GROUP BY flghf.fh_nr, flghf.bez ORDER BY total_cargo DESC LIMIT 5
H07-SCH: SELECT flghf.fh_nr, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(sndg.ges_gew_kg / 1000) DESC) AS rank FROM flug_ladg JOIN flug ON flug_ladg.flug_id = flug.flug_id JOIN flghf ON flug.abfl_fh = flghf.fh_nr JOIN sndg ON flug_ladg.sndg_nr = sndg.sndg_nr JOIN knd_stamm ON sndg.kunnr = knd_stamm.kunnr WHERE flug_ladg.abschn_stat = 'flown' GROUP BY flghf.fh_nr HAVING rank BETWEEN 1 AND 5
H07-BIZ: SELECT flghf.bez, SUM(sdg_verfolg.gew_kg) AS outbound_tonnage FROM flghf JOIN sdg_verfolg ON flghf.fh_nr = sdg_verfolg.fh_nr WHERE sdg_verfolg.ereig_cd = 'DEP' GROUP BY flghf.bez ORDER BY outbound_tonnage DESC LIMIT 5
H07-VAG: SELECT flghf.bez, COUNT(zoll_anm.anm_id) AS export_count FROM flghf JOIN zoll_anm ON flghf.fh_nr = zoll_anm.sndg_nr WHERE zoll_anm.anm_art = 'export' GROUP BY flghf.bez ORDER BY export_count DESC LIMIT 10
H08-CAS: SELECT lfz_typ.mdl, COUNT(flug.flug_id) FROM lfz JOIN lfz_typ ON lfz.typ_nr = lfz_typ.typ_nr JOIN flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug.lfz_nr JOIN betankg ON flug.flug_id = betankg.flug_id WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' AND betankg.verbr_kg > (lfz_typ.max_vol_m3 * 0.5)
H08-SCH: SELECT T4.mdl, COUNT(*) FROM flug_ladg AS T1 JOIN flug AS T2 ON T1.flug_id = T2.flug_id JOIN sndg AS T3 ON T1.sndg_nr = T3.sndg_nr JOIN lfz_typ AS T4 ON T4.typ_nr = T3.waren_kat WHERE T2.stat = 'completed' AND T1.abschn_stat = 'flown' GROUP BY T4.mdl HAVING SUM(T3.ges_vol_m3) > 0.5 * T4.max_vol_m3
H08-BIZ: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT flug.lfz_nr) FROM lfz JOIN flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug.lfz_nr JOIN flug_ladg ON flug.flug_id = flug_ladg.flug_id JOIN lfz_typ ON lfz.typ_nr = lfz_typ.typ_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' AND flug_ladg.abschn_stat = 'flown' AND flug_ladg.pos_cd = 'main' AND flug_ladg.uld_typ = 'PAG' AND (flug_ladg.lade_folge / (lfz_typ.max_vol_m3 * 1000)) > 0.5
H08-VAG: SELECT lfz_typ.mdl FROM lfz JOIN lfz_typ ON lfz.typ_nr = lfz_typ.typ_nr JOIN flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug.lfz_nr WHERE lfz.stat = 'active' AND flug.abfl_ist IS NOT NULL AND flug.ank_ist IS NOT NULL AND (flug.tow_kg - lfz_typ.max_nutzl_kg) / lfz_typ.max_nutzl_kg BETWEEN 0.4 AND 0.6
H09-CAS: SELECT lfz.lfz_nr FROM lfz JOIN flghf ON lfz.heimat_fh_nr = flghf.fh_nr JOIN sndg ON lfz.lfz_nr = sndg.lfz_nr WHERE flghf.hub_kz = 1 GROUP BY lfz.lfz_nr HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sndg.ziel_fh) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flghf WHERE hub_kz = 1)
H09-SCH: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT flghf.fh_nr) FROM flghf JOIN flug ON flghf.fh_nr = flug.ziel_fh JOIN bes_eins ON flug.flug_id = bes_eins.flug_id WHERE flghf.hub_kz = 1 AND flug.stat = 'completed' AND bes_eins.eins_stat = 'completed'
H09-BIZ: SELECT lfz.lfz_nr FROM lfz JOIN flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug.lfz_nr JOIN bes_eins ON flug.flug_id = bes_eins.flug_id JOIN wartg ON lfz.lfz_nr = wartg.lfz_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' AND bes_eins.eins_stat = 'completed' AND wartg.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY lfz.lfz_nr HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT flug.abfl_fh) = ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fh_nr) FROM flghf WHERE hub_kz = 1 )
H09-VAG: SELECT lfz.lfz_nr FROM lfz JOIN flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug.lfz_nr GROUP BY lfz.lfz_nr HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT flug.abfl_fh) > 1
H10-CAS: SELECT zoll_land, COUNT(*) FROM zoll_anm WHERE anm_art = 'import' AND (zoll_betr_usd + eust_usd) / zollwert_usd > 0.20 GROUP BY zoll_land
H10-SCH: SELECT zoll_land, COUNT(*) FROM zoll_anm WHERE anm_art = 'import' AND zoll_betr_usd + eust_usd > 0.2 * zollwert_usd GROUP BY zoll_land
H10-BIZ: SELECT zoll_land, COUNT(*) FROM zoll_anm WHERE anm_art = 'import' AND zollsatz_pct > 20
H10-VAG: SELECT zoll_anm.zoll_land FROM zoll_anm JOIN lgr ON zoll_anm.lgr_nr = lgr.lgr_nr WHERE zoll_anm.anm_art = 'import' AND lgr.sich_stufe = 'high'
